Hello, Zuzu! 

I've really fallen in love with the semi-animated pictures you've been drawing, so I've come to request one myself! 

My character, Mir, is a pink sea bunny who loves to educate about the beautiful ocean and all of the life in it. She's themed around a nudibranch, which I've included a picture of. Her most distinct and unusual features are her freckles, but also her pink spots on the white part of her hair. 

Her character is summery and fun. She's got a bright, optimistic attitude, but she can be a little cynical sometimes, too. She'd love to be a mascot for an aquarium someday. 

I see that you like to use flower motifs too, so I've included a pink hibiscus like one might find on a tropical island. If you could also include a sea angel (clionid) like the little guy I've also added, that would be greatly appreciated!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TPu96NUQkGvHvI7ep68sV1wr6NnxuVr6?usp=drive_link
